topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: I can’t believe it, the house—it’s ours, or rather, it’s mine and my brother’s. I’ve been going through the papers, trying to make sense of it all. There’s so much to do, repairs, bills, lawyers. I keep thinking about Gran, how she’d want us to keep it, but the upkeep... it’s overwhelming. Every room holds memories, but also ghosts. I’m alone here now, and the silence is deafening. I need to talk to my brother, figure out if we can really do this, if we should. But what if we can’t agree, what if... I just need to breathe, to think. This house, it’s a part of us, but it feels like it might consume us whole.
